name: HotelQuEST
description: Agentic search has emerged as a promising paradigm for adaptive retrieval systems powered by large language models (LLMs). However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on quality, overlooking efficiency factors that are critical for real-world deployment. Moreover, real-world user queries often contain underspecified preferences, a challenge that remains largely underexplored in current agentic search evaluation. As a result, many agentic search systems remain impractical despite their impressive performance.
